One History for every note.

### 🚀 Features
- **History** lives in the editor and lists only versions that differ.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Undo no longer turns a note back into raw source.
- Card previews show empty list items.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.1.7...v0.1.8](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.1.7...v0.1.8)
